title: Verdict
description: The runtime's decision about a GuardEvent. Two decisions: allow | block. Redaction is not a decision — a non-empty modifications.spans on an allow says it. "Flag" is not a decision — allow with findings says it.

event_id.description: Runtime-assigned identity of the judged event, returned to the caller here.

action.description: What this finding contributed to the decision.

path.description: Payload path of the judged text, e.g. payload.tool_calls.1.arguments.command. Registration contract: paths name locations the producer registered when building the event.

fp.description: Whitelist fingerprint: a hash of the finding's subject, minted by the engine. Never the value itself.

whitelisted.description: True when an operator whitelisted this exact subject: the finding is recorded but contributes nothing to the decision.

subject.description: The detected value this finding is about, as the producer sent it — at most one per finding, and what an operator's false-positive exception keys on. NOT a per-span echo of matched text, which findings MUST NOT carry.

unjudged.description: Payload paths this verdict could NOT judge. Absent or empty asserts every routed text was judged; a fail-closed enforcement point MUST treat a non-empty value as "could not look", which is not "found nothing".
